scientific_goal: Determine whether stronger endpoint diagonal-variance matching can preserve the h20 position-weight-2 TCN's favorable autonomous covariance while stationary-mean matching corrects its POD and spatial-mean bias, and separate those effects from ordinary checkpoint continuation.
scientific_constraints: Warm-start every trial independently from the same fresh_tcn15_joint_es_pos2_vel1_h20_e5 checkpoint. Do not chain refinements or change the restoring-only TCN15 architecture, full constant diffusion, rank, data split, normalization, stored 50 Hz high-pass spatial mean or exact 5 percent training trim.
Use validation repetitions 13 and 14 for selection. Test repetitions 15 and 16 remain locked.

Retain the parent's joint displacement-velocity energy-score objective: horizons 2,4,10,20, equal horizon weights, position weight 2, velocity weight 1, four particles, joint drift-and-diffusion gradients and batch sampling on 0.5 percent of batches.

Run exactly three matched one-epoch continuations: zero moment weights, mean weight 0.01 with variance weight 0.003, and mean weight 0.01 with variance weight 0.01. Keep learning rate 1e-5 and every other training option fixed.

The zero-moment continuation is required to quantify changes caused by ordinary one-step-NLL and joint-energy-score continuation. Do not attribute a difference from the parent to moment matching unless it also differs from this continuation control.

Moment endpoints are 100,200,500 native steps. Use 64 distinct measured starts per selected update and score 1.25 percent of batches, with two independent stochastic branches per start and trim-valid paths through every endpoint.
The spatial-mean coordinate participates in moment matching but contributes zero capillary deformation energy. Report its bias and variance separately from POD covariance and deformation energy.

Screen every candidate on the same 32 full-strength validation paths for 5000 steps. Compare energy, POD mean, covariance, leading-mode variance and mean, spatial-mean statistics, nonmean PSD, one-step behavior, innovation calibration, survival and boundedness.

A useful variance weight must improve energy and covariance relative to both the zero-moment control and the 0.003 arm while retaining most of the mean correction. Endpoint loss reduction alone is insufficient.
After all three screens, the advisor may promote at most one trial to a 50000-step validation confirmation or stop. No additional training trial is allowed.
advisor_guidance: The shared h20 position-weight-2 parent has trimmed-reference energy 1.460, POD covariance trace 1.287, covariance relative error 0.341, POD mean standardized RMSE 0.276, spatial-mean standardized bias 0.949 and spatial-mean variance ratio 0.815. A previous one-epoch mean 0.01 plus variance 0.001 continuation reached mean RMSE 0.105 but worsened energy to 1.577 and covariance trace to 1.644. In a matched h50 comparison, raising variance weight from zero to 0.003 improved energy 1.528 to 1.489 and covariance trace 1.597 to 1.543, but worsened mean RMSE 0.100 to 0.113 and did not improve spatial-mean variance. The first three POD modes retained variance ratios 1.625,1.544,1.390 and accounted for about 77 percent of net energy excess. Decide from autonomous rollout evidence. The zero-moment arm diagnoses whether the common overdispersed refinement basin is produced by ordinary continuation. Because the training budget is exhausted after the queued arms, choose only promote or stop.

seed_runs.hypothesis: The h20 position-weight-2 checkpoint supplies the best screened covariance and nonmean PSD and is the common immutable parent for all three continuations.

initial_trials.hypothesis: The overdispersed refinement basin may be caused mainly by ordinary one-step-NLL and joint-energy-score continuation rather than by the endpoint moment penalties.
initial_trials.expected_observation: If continuation is the main cause, POD covariance and energy will inflate toward the previous refined models even with both moment weights zero; if they remain near the parent, the moment objectives caused the movement.

initial_trials.hypothesis: Variance weight 0.003 is strong enough to oppose continuation-driven leading-mode variance inflation while mean weight 0.01 corrects the parent bias.
initial_trials.expected_observation: Lower mean error than the parent, with energy and covariance closer to one than both the zero-moment control and the prior variance-0.001 refinement, finite paths and preserved nonmean PSD.

initial_trials.hypothesis: Variance weight 0.01 supplies enough stationary-amplitude gradient to correct modes 1-3 instead of merely slowing their inflation.
initial_trials.expected_observation: Energy and covariance improve beyond the 0.003 arm without covariance undershoot, loss of the mean correction, spatial-mean degradation, spectral distortion or instability.
